in_marathi.name: Kamanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Passion, Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamanth is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘kama’, meaning desire or passion. It is a name that evokes feelings of strong emotions, love, and attachment. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva, the god of love and desire, is often referred to as Kamanth. The name is also said to bring good fortune and prosperity.
